summary:
I saved 4 views of NutriTrace, a self-hosted nutrition tracker. I couldn't save a fifth because replay sign-ins started failing partway through.

Saved views:
1. diary: today's food diary. It has the week strip, the fasting tracker, meal cards with logged foods, and a side panel with the macro ring and water log.
2. foods-catalog: the Foods catalog, with source and category filters and a grid of food cards. "Atlantic Salmon Fillet" is selected, so its Nutrition Facts label shows in the side preview.
3. statistics: the metric list and a one-month calorie bar chart with average, goal and trend lines. It also has a summary panel and the daily history list.
4. wellness-sleep: the Wellness page on its Sleep tab, with the sleep-stage bar, metric cards with small trend lines, and a sleep-debt panel.

What didn't work:
- Trace AI chat panel: it opens and shows a past conversation, but saving it failed every time. The first try replayed to a completely different screen. Two more tries couldn't find the "Open AI coach" button, even though it was there in my own session.
- Goals page: after that, a plain view with no clicks also replayed to a completely different screen (about 1% text match). Saving it failed twice, including once after a minute of waiting.
- Likely cause: the app's login rate limit or lockout, set off by the many replay sign-ins, which would leave replays on the sign-in screen. I never saw the replayed screenshots, so I can't confirm it. I stopped there so further sign-ins wouldn't extend a lockout.
- Possible effect on the saved views: if the lockout is still active when the 4 views are replayed for capture, they may fail as well.

Not explored: Settings, and the Meals and Recipes tabs in Foods.

Data changes: I didn't change any data. I opened the Trace chat during testing and closed it again afterwards.
